readiness.title: Visual exploration
readiness.detail: Two conceptual reactor models; component inspection, cutaways, electrical replay and a six-case 3D transport lab.

readiness.title: Research and reproducibility
readiness.detail: 84 readable records, source hashes and admitted tests. Full historical raw-data integration is incomplete; private correspondence is excluded.

readiness.title: Source-linked neutron transport
readiness.detail: Candidate-profile-derived direct-source banks drive local header comparisons. This is not a full-reactor breeding calculation.

readiness.title: Experimental reactor validation
readiness.detail: No working reactor, sustained net electricity, measured equilibrium, or qualified magnet lifetime has been demonstrated by this project.

readiness.title: Integrated fuel and cooling
readiness.detail: Matched full geometry, return flux, breeder benchmarks, fuel recovery and thermal/structural closure remain acceptance gates.

readiness.title: Live public execution
readiness.detail: GitHub Pages displays published snapshots. New solver runs and contributor code execution are not offered by the static site.

milestones.title: Whole-plant heating/current-drive allocation tested
milestones.summary: At fixed major radius and heating electricity, a controlled systems comparison gives100MW greater modeled burn net output. The remaining control allocation is unvalidated; higher heat loads and changed components remain obligations. Six solves and both failures preserved.

milestones.title: Existing lithium benchmark checked; prior-work register published
milestones.summary: Recovered one-million-history LiF leakage replay; preserved original measurements, normalization disagreement, all bins, credits and reopen conditions. No reactor validation or power improvement claimed.

milestones.title: Existing HCPB validation identified and credited
milestones.summary: Novais and Peterson already published the relevant OpenMC tritium benchmark. Full reproduction remains open; its9% mean discrepancy is not a correction to our candidate. The credited prior-work register prevents duplicate discovery claims.

milestones.title: Plasma-to-blanket source coupling
milestones.summary: Four recorded runs use candidate-linked position/direction banks. The front-header local yield penalty persists; source geometry and reactor return-flux uncertainty remain.

milestones.title: Recorded trajectories and 3D heating
milestones.summary: Source-direction stress tests and actual OpenMC trajectories/voxel scores were linked to the Unreal and browser 3D lab. No fabricated coolant velocity or temperature field.

milestones.title: Header placement enters neutron transport
milestones.summary: Equal-inventory local cells were compared using six runs. The front layout was not accepted solely on its hydraulic result.

milestones.title: Evidence reader and confinement accounting
milestones.summary: Full cleared reports and superseded findings became searchable. Known accounting conventions were applied without claiming new fusion physics.

milestones.title: Full-system numerical reference
milestones.summary: The lifetime-constrained systems model converged with positive conditional modeled net electricity. It is not a qualified 30-year magnet or measured power plant.
